name: How much does it cost to build a block wall?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a block wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a block wall varies based on several factors, including the wall's length and height, the type of blocks used, foundation requirements, site accessibility, and any special finishes or features like gates. On average, residential block walls can range from $25 to $50 per linear foot for basic installations. For a precise estimate, we recommend scheduling a site visit, as this allows us to assess your specific needs and provide a detailed, accurate quote tailored to your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Block wall costs vary by length, height, block type, and features, typically ranging from $25 to $50 per linear foot for basic builds.
